sloka: रुदन्तम् इव वृक्षैः च ग्लान पुष्प मृग द्विजम् ।श्रिया विहीनम् विध्वस्तम् संत्यक्त वन दैवतैः ॥३-६०-६॥
transliteration: rudantam iva vṛkṣaiḥ ca glāna puṣpa mṛga dvijam ।śriyā vihīnam vidhvastam saṁtyakta vana daivataiḥ ॥3-60-6॥

translations.english: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.
